## Checklist

### Quality
- [ ] My contribution is useful to a real person
- [ ] Information is accurate and current; sources are cited for statistics
- [ ] This is my own original work (not copied from courses, blogs, or other repos)
- [ ] Language is clear and appropriate for the target audience

### Safety rules
- [ ] No malware, ransomware, or credential stealers
- [ ] No working phishing kits or clones of real login pages
- [ ] No attacks on real organizations or systems
- [ ] No real credentials, API keys, or personal data
- [ ] No unpatched vulnerabilities in real products
- [ ] Phishing examples use fictional companies and `example.com`
- [ ] Labs are deliberately vulnerable and run locally / in a sandbox only

### Format
- [ ] File is in the correct track folder
- [ ] YAML front matter is filled in (for guides, labs, tools)
- [ ] File uses lowercase, hyphenated naming
